place.name: Nauthólsvík
place.description: Nauthólsvík (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈnœytˌhoulsˌviːk], "bull hill bay") is a Seaside resort and a small neighbourhood in Reykjavík, the capital city of Iceland, about 900 metres (3,000 ft) from Perlan. It has a beach with an artificial hot spring – hot water is pumped into a man-made lagoon.
